question: Can two independently trained, distinct alternative encoders agreeing against the incumbent identify correctable mistakes out of sample? Keep the prior expanded-budget incumbent as selected in its sealed unhinted run. No model names or dataset identity enter the decision function.
material: Reuse only the original five training OOF partitions. Each base model used in one partition was trained outside the entire partition. Do not use the new regrouped study's outputs or any designated / final / H2 labels. Require exact alignment and actual distinct encoder IDs from configurations. Do not choose the number of roles or any thresholds after looking at results.
roles: In each held fold hash each connected component under a fixed prefix into three roles. Rotate learning, confirmation and evaluation cyclically. No information from another fold is used to train a gate. For each row the gate that scores it is selected and confirmed using other components only. The three rotations have overlapping learning samples across roles and must not be counted as independent experiments.
candidate_rules: Generate every pair of available alternatives with distinct encoder IDs, both different from those of the incumbent. When both predict the same class against the incumbent's equal probability vote, consider a switch. Consider all such switches, or only those whose weaker challenger absolute margin less the incumbent absolute margin meets the median or 75th percentile of opposed learning rows. Each threshold is fitted only to the learning role. Require at least five non-tied learning groups. Order by net examples gained then positive minus negative groups then fewer changed examples, then simpler threshold and executable configuration. The operation may keep the incumbent.
confirmation: Keep the single learning winner only if it gains examples on learning, gains examples on confirmation, has at least five non-tied confirmation groups, and wins a one-sided exact sign test across those groups at p <= 0.10. Never consult the evaluation role to select, confirm or switch. Compare with the learning nominee without the confirmation gate, and the same pair always switching at unanimous opposition.
promotion: For eligibility to integrate into the autonomous run, the conservative policy must gain at least 0.3 percentage points pooled over the 8301 unique rows, win strictly on at least three of the five original folds, and avoid losing more than 0.3 percentage points on any fold. Signed group tests are a development heuristic, not a significance claim on prior research data. Count all 15 supervised rule selections separately. Zero new encoder/classifier fits, no model APIs.
